disposition_reason: Table 1 prints per-product As, Cd, Pb, Hg, Tl and Cu (mg/kg) for 36 coded protein supplements sold in India.

study.design: Blinded market survey of 36 popular protein supplements (14 blends, 4 plant-based, 18 whey-based/whey-blended; 20 made in India) analysed by an FSSAI-approved laboratory
study.origin: 20 products made in India, the rest by multinational companies (country of manufacture per product not given)
study.market: manufacturer stores (online or offline) and authorized dealers, Kerala, India
study.method: ICP-MS for As, Cd, Pb, Hg, Tl, Cu (details in Supplemental Document 2, not available)
study.qa: Internal standards, calibration checks and validation protocols 'as per industry standards'; no recoveries or CRM results printed
